This is a Halloween decorative item, so it falls under heading 9505 (festive articles). Within that heading, 9505.10 covers Christmas articles and 9505.90 covers other festive articles. The relevant subheading is 9505.90.60 ("Other" festive, carnival or other entertainment articles), which has the 10-digit statistical suffix 9505.90.6000.

I recall that CBP rulings on Halloween wall and door decor with ribbon bows classify them under 9505.90.6000. I did not look up a specific ruling, so I am relying on memory for that.

An alternative would be 6307.90 or 3926.40, but the principal use as a Halloween festive article points to heading 9505.
